title: Dashboard navigation and retry reliability
items: Kept Starboard and Backups visually scoped to the Dashboard navigation group so feature links no longer appear again under Account or Resources.
Added a short cooldown for rate-limited dashboard GET requests so repeated render observers reuse the same failure instead of immediately hammering the API again.
Kept the in-dashboard Meowz/current-server switcher available for changing servers while preserving cached server snapshots, unsaved-change protection and responsive behavior.
Restored normal dashboard footer flow so short server tabs no longer let the footer cover or cut through dashboard content.
